variants.with_traces: Current v6 compiler with the frozen autonomous interaction summaries visible in the prompt.
variants.without_traces: The identical v6 prompt inputs and branch slots, except the autonomous interaction summaries are replaced by an empty list.

quality.qualification_rule: all flags true in both repeats

decision_rule.with_traces_add_value: with_traces mean score is at least one point higher and its strict qualified rate is not lower
decision_rule.no_material_increment: absolute mean score difference is below one
decision_rule.raw_traces_may_add_noise: without_traces mean score is at least one point higher and its strict qualified rate is not lower
decision_rule.low_reliability: if either variant has score-within-one or branch-flag repeat agreement below 80%, semantic direction is inconclusive

interpretation_limits: This isolates trace visibility at compilation time, not the effect of simulation on the post-simulation decisions.
One scenario generation draw is used per variant and case.
The same economical model family generates and judges the scenarios.
No historical outcomes, price labels, forecast calibration, or trading returns are evaluated.

input_rule: without_traces uses the shared input with simulated_actions replaced by []; original case IDs are replaced in the display protocol
